assertions.name: closed_form_holds_on_no_constructed_candidate
assertions.source: eps(Delta) = h^2/2 - h holds on: none of the four -- so the 27-site incumbent value comes from the 1-/2-crossing SHORT model alone, not from any element built here

assertions.name: D1_unavailable_for_every_long_model
assertions.source: (D1) affine in z for: none -- the z^2 coefficient is nonzero on all four, so alpha = (z-1)h/2 is not the counit-minus-trace gap on any of them

assertions.name: bg3w_has_L_plus_and_L_minus_swapped
assertions.source: L- = 0 (vanishes) and L+ = -h*(h**2 + 2)/4 = -0.10681445765158, which reproduces qou-vtlj cont.7's closed form -(q^2-1)(q^4+1)/(4q^3) = -0.10681445765158 to 30 dps. So qou-vtlj is right and qou-bg3w's attribution is swapped: the (D1) exclusion rides on L+, not L-

assertions.name: z2_test_needs_the_sum_not_one_coordinate
assertions.source: [z^2] = d[L+] + d[L-] + h*d[e^-]; on this element L- and e^- both vanish so it collapses to L+ alone -- but that is a property of this element, not of the test

assertions.name: e_minus_nonzero_on_some_long_models
assertions.source: e^- coordinate is nonzero on 2/3: ['nuc9_build_nucleon_nf', 'nuc11_interleaved_build_atom_nf_exact']. qbeta-counit-closed-form.md's 'both nucleon models happen to satisfy' e^- = 0 does NOT hold across the candidate set, so the coordinate-sum/tr_M|_{z=1} agreement it licenses is element-specific and must not be carried to another candidate

assertions.name: bg3w_nuc9_residual_is_the_pin_not_float64
assertions.source: qou-bg3w calls -0.1883216147 the EXACT net and -0.188290601 the float64 coordinate sum, and attributes the gap to 'float64 h versus exact _H_FRAC'. Measured: the same exact expression gives -0.18832161472187 at q = 111/100 and -0.18829060147138 at the proton pin. The gap is 185 ppm of PIN, not float64 rounding (which would be ~1e-16). Both of bg3w's numbers are exact; they are at different q

assertions.name: constructed_recipe_is_assignment_dependent
assertions.source: 16 readings of the blocks' recipe (8 quark-generator assignments x 2 Hopf orientations) give net(Delta) spanning [-0.250674285119, -0.204683501916] -- 6 distinct values. The corpus fixes the SHIFTS but not the generators, so 'the constructed Delta' is not a single number without a selection rule. Variants reproducing the blocks' stated net(n) = 0.7975664: ['gens=(0, 0, 0),hopf=L-', 'gens=(0, 1, 1),hopf=L-']

assertions.name: bg3w_and_vtlj_bottom_rows_are_one_element_at_two_pins
assertions.source: gen-grouped net = -0.233197711316 at q_0 (vtlj's -0.2331977) vs -0.233245896072 at q = 111/100 (bg3w's -0.2332459); rel 0.0002066. Same element, two pins -- NOT two elements

assertions.name: neutron_reproducing_variants_agree_and_match_vtlj
assertions.source: 2 of 16 readings reproduce the blocks' stated net(n) = 0.7975664, and both give the SAME net(Delta) = -0.21376383061666, independently reproducing qou-vtlj's constructed value -0.2137638. So within this parameterisation the neutron constraint DOES pin Delta -- the assignment freedom that spans [-0.2507, -0.2047] collapses once the stated neutron net is imposed. Note this pins Delta from the NEUTRON alone; qou-vtlj separately found no reading reproduces the stated PROTON net, so the pin rests on one of the block's two numbers

assertions.name: candidate_set_exceeds_the_four_each_bean_reports
assertions.source: 11 distinct net values at ONE pin: 3 constructed models, the published closed form, the blocks' stated -0.2089, and 6 distinct values from the 16 readings of the blocks' own recipe. Both qou-bg3w and qou-vtlj report 'FOUR', and their fours differ; neither figure is the size of the candidate set

description: Census of the Delta-element candidates at ONE pin (proton q_0) in ONE basis. qou-bg3w and qou-vtlj each report FOUR values; their lists differ, so the union is six. Per candidate: net, whether (D1) is affine in z, the e^- coordinate, and whether the published closed form eps(Delta) = h^2/2 - h holds. Selects nothing; scope-(a).

data.q0_anchor_note: proton pin; every value in this witness is at Q_50_DIGIT_STR, none at q = 111/100
